# #511 — Pi adapter: force the Python hook stack into the Pi harness against the local dogfood brain

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none

## Destination

Pi runs the same Open Brain client structure this box just proved: canon SessionStart injection, capture hooks (Stop/SubagentStop/SessionEnd/PostCompact), and the three enforcement gates (context-budget, policy-refresh, ob-guard) — all from the installed `python/openbrain` + `python/openbrain-provider` packages, pointed at the **local dogfood brain**. State: PROPOSED.

Pi is fully operator-controlled, which makes it the cross-model proving ground: the same memory contract exercised by GPT-family models instead of Claude. The adapter delta is itself the signal the Wayfinder map (#443) named — if the contract has to bend for Pi, the contract is wrong, not the runtime.

## Scope

- Install the uv tool set (`openbrain` 0.9.x console scripts + `openbrain-provider` gates) into Pi's runtime environment.
- Wire Pi's hook surface (whatever its lifecycle events map to) to the same wrapper-invoked console scripts used in `~/.claude/settings.json` post-swap (2026-08-02).
- Env file per the established single-switch pattern (`OPENBRAIN_BASE_URL`/`OPENBRAIN_TOKEN`); Pi gets its own consumer token + namespace decision per the fleet plan (PR #500 open questions).
- Prove: canon pack injection, capture round-trip row in `ob_session_events`, gate verdicts sane under Pi.

## Constraints

- **Dogfood-scoped.** Nothing repoints for any other consumer until the core01 swap-back (operator rule, 2026-08-02). mcp2cli for everyone else stays on core01.
- Sequenced after 0.9.0 soak, alongside #492. Do not start until the operator green-lights the lane.

Refs: #443 (map — "Claude first, then adapters for Claudex, Codex, and Pi"), PR #500 (fleet rollout plan), #492 (post-0.9.0 sequencing).
